scripts.start: concurrently -n api,dashboard -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @brain/api dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:${API_PORT:-3000}/network -t 30000 && pnpm --filter @brain/dashboard dev"
scripts.start:attention: concurrently -n api,dashboard,seed -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @brain/api dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:${API_PORT:-3000}/network -t 30000 && pnpm --filter @brain/dashboard dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:${API_PORT:-3000}/network -t 30000 && node scripts/seed-attention.mjs"
scripts.setup:all: pnpm -w run setup:intent && pnpm -w run setup:voice && pnpm -w run setup:gaze
scripts.dev:gaze: concurrently -n gaze-api,gaze-web -c yellow,magenta "pnpm run dev:gaze:server" "wait-on http-get://localhost:8766/api/health -t 60000 && pnpm run dev:gaze:web"
scripts.dev:gaze:server: node scripts/pyenv.mjs run nodes/gaze -- uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8766 --reload
scripts.dev:voice: concurrently -n voice-api,voice-web -c cyan,green "pnpm run dev:voice:server" "wait-on http-get://localhost:8765/api/health -t 30000 && pnpm run dev:voice:web"
scripts.dev:voice:server: node scripts/pyenv.mjs run nodes/voice -- VOICE_ENGINE=real uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --reload
scripts.dev:intent: concurrently -n intent-api,intent-web -c magenta,cyan "pnpm run dev:intent:server" "wait-on http-get://localhost:8767/api/health -t 30000 && pnpm run dev:intent:web"
scripts.dev:intent:server: node scripts/pyenv.mjs run nodes/intent -- uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8767 --reload
